launch_authority_semantics: launch_authorized=false records only the present planned/inactive state; it adds no authority requirement beyond the parent experiment's standing operator gate

parent_spec_binding.ordered_payload_encoding: compact sorted-key ensure_ascii JSON array of exact {name,sha256} pairs, without trailing LF
parent_spec_binding.noncircularity: The three parent files contain no bundle hash; this child contract binds their already-frozen raw bytes.

child_fixture_binding.gate_rule: The future fixed controller gate rejects before candidate execution if either raw fixture hash differs.
child_fixture_binding.noncircularity: TASK_CONTRACT.json is intentionally excluded from this child fixture hash set and is bound separately by the runner task-contract digest when promoted.

deliverables.boundary: exact_files means candidate-authored deliverables copied into the isolated gate input; controller-created AGENTS.md, inputs/, TASK_CONTRACT.md, logs, sandbox state, response files, and archived attempts are outside that enumeration and never imported as candidate code
deliverables.public_api_rule: the seven listed callables are the exact non-underscore module callables; proof-only helpers must start with one underscore and confer no additional validation, receipt, storage, or execution authority
deliverables.report_contract: REPORT.md is UTF-8 LF text, at most report_max_bytes, begins with Status: `experiment`, describes only the implemented S0 validation surface, repeats the T118 r,w provenance deferral, and contains no production result, PASS authority, CAS/receipt existence claim, or Pi/density/cancellation/V1 claim

common: every public API is deterministic and must not mutate any supplied value
a rejected input raises ValueError or a ValueError subclass; returning False, a diagnostic string, or partial output is not rejection
validators return exactly None on acceptance

returns.canonical_json_bytes(value): returns exact built-in bytes containing compact sorted-key ensure_ascii JSON plus one LF
returns.decode_canonical_json(raw): accepts exact built-in bytes only and returns the parsed JSON value after all canonical-byte and resource checks
returns.validate_point(value, expected_n): returns None after exact point validation; expected_n is a JSON-style integer but not bool
returns.recompute_window(points, window_index, s: returns a newly allocated complete window_artifact object with every derived field recomputed from points
returns.validate_window_bytes(raw, window_index,: returns the decoded complete window_artifact object only after strict decoding, independent recomputation from its points, and exact equality of every stored derived field
returns.validate_cas_record(value, expected_bind: returns None only when the exact CAS schema and every exact expected binding agree
returns.validate_receipt(value, expected_binding: returns None only when the exact receipt schema and every exact expected binding agree

resource_limits.limit_semantics: limits are inclusive maxima except timeout; the controller tests each exact boundary and one-over rejection without allocating adversarial one-over fixtures larger than the stated byte cap

allowed: strict canonical JSON byte parsing and serialization
integer-only recomputation from supplied normalized points
forbidden: BBP terms, partial sums, Q/F/H/d/e/X/k/W/R generation, Fraction, or any production arithmetic
filesystem writes, CAS storage, receipt minting, subprocesses, network, dynamic imports, reflection, or code execution
candidate-authored tests, pass flags, manifests, receipts, or self-test authority
floats, decimal approximations, random inputs, clock-dependent values, or environment-dependent behavior

canonical_raw_bytes.json_value_domain: recursive exact built-in None,bool,int,str,list,dict with string keys only; floats, subclasses, tuples, sets, custom mappings, and custom sequences are rejected; booleans remain valid generic JSON but never satisfy an integer schema field
canonical_raw_bytes.limit_measurement: raw byte length includes the final LF; root scalar has nesting depth 0 and each containing list or dict adds 1; array/object limits apply independently to every container; integer-string digit count excludes one permitted leading minus
parser_requirements: input type is bytes and bounded by the controller
UTF-8 without BOM; ASCII canonical output; LF only; exactly one final LF
reject duplicate object keys with object_pairs_hook
reject floats with parse_float and NaN/Infinity with parse_constant
reject invalid UTF-8, BOM, CRLF, missing/folded/multiple final LF, whitespace, parsed-equivalent noncanonical bytes, excessive nesting, and excessive size
after strict parse, raw bytes must equal canonical_json_bytes(parsed)

frozen_acceptance.argument_rule: window_index,start_n,end_exclusive_n must equal exactly one row; arbitrary 256-index ranges and any other syntactically valid SHA-256 are rejected
frozen_acceptance.index_scope: S0 authenticates exact consecutive n metadata only. It cannot authenticate whether otherwise valid supplied r,w came from T118 orbit N+1; that belongs to the later disjoint arithmetic verifier.

point.types: n and cell are JSON integers but not booleans; r and w are canonical nonnegative integer strings

lag_record.types: all four fields are JSON integers but not booleans
laws: records are exactly lag 1..255 in order

maximum_determinant_ratio.types: num and den are canonical nonnegative integer strings; the remaining fields are JSON integers but not booleans
laws: witness_n<witness_m are in the window and have the recorded same cell
the ratio is maximal by integer cross multiplication over distinct same-cell pairs

decision.types: j_threshold_pass and has_zero_distinct_pair are JSON booleans; c_sum and a_sum are nonnegative JSON integers but not booleans; window13_action is a JSON string
actions_in_priority_order: stop_audit_zero if the J test passes and any Z_l>0
go_holdouts if the J test passes, every Z_l=0, and A_sum<=3512

cas_record.types: size_bytes,window_index,start_n,end_exclusive_n are nonnegative JSON integers but not booleans; both SHA-256 fields are lowercase 64-hex strings; other fields are strings
cas_record.authority: validation only; only the future controller may store bytes or create this record

receipt.types: window_index,start_n,end_exclusive_n are nonnegative JSON integers but not booleans; all four SHA-256 fields are lowercase 64-hex strings; other fields are strings
receipt.binding: controller_gate_id and every digest/range field must equal the controller-supplied expected binding
receipt.authority: validation only; candidate code must never mint or claim an accepted receipt, and the S0 gate ID is not a production receipt authority

controller_recomputation: require exactly 256 ordered points whose n fields are the exact consecutive metadata start_n..end_exclusive_n-1; do not claim S0 authenticates T118 r,w provenance
recompute n0..n9 and require their sum is 256
for every lag 1..255 recompute Delta, C_l, A_l, and Z_l
require J=256+2*sum C_l, C_l<=A_l, and Z_l<=A_l
recompute the raw maximum same-cell determinant ratio and lexicographically first witness
recompute c_sum, a_sum, zero flag, and window13_action with the frozen priority rule
never accept candidate-reported summaries or decisions without exact equality to recomputation

controller_image_dispatch.rule: the runner resolves the configured controller image once to a lowercase 64-hex immutable image ID before candidate execution and passes that exact ID into the fixed S0 gate; the gate executes the same ID and never a mutable tag
controller_image_dispatch.required_test: a fixed runner dispatch test must inject a sentinel immutable ID, assert the S0 run_gate call receives it, and assert the isolated pod command contains that ID and no mutable image tag
controller_image_dispatch.isolation: network none, read-only root, dropped ALL capabilities, no-new-privileges, exact pids/cpu/memory/timeout limits, bounded nosuid,nodev tmpfs, candidate and harness mounted read-only without broad run-directory mounts

nonclaims: This is a planned task specification, not an implementation or active task.
No CAS object or accepted controller receipt exists merely because its schema is specified.
No BBP value, production window, J10 outcome, pair count, occupancy, density, cancellation, V1, or Pi result is computed or claimed.
